RagShortTexts: Athanaric joins followers through judgment and chiefly cooperation.
Religion, kin and service demands need not align.

Variants.Content: Athanaric joins followers through judgment and cooperation. Religion, kin and service do not always align, while chiefs assess their own safety.

Athanaric joins followers through judgment and chiefly cooperation. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Religion, kin and service demands need not align.
Religion, kin and service demands need not align. Coordination allocates actual supply and protection duties, not merely titles. Athanaric joins followers through judgment and chiefly cooperation.

Athanaric joins followers through judgment and chiefly cooperation. Households compare burdens with neighbors; unmatched protection weakens cooperation. Religion, kin and service demands need not align.

Religion, kin and service demands need not align. One promise may not bind every receiver, guard and supplier; negotiation needs actual responsibility. Athanaric joins followers through judgment and chiefly cooperation.
